extracted.name: Black forest breakfast bowl
extracted.description: Enjoy the flavours of this classic dessert in a healthy breakfast. It's a tasty combination of cholesterol-lowering oats, heart-healthy soya yogurt, nuts, seeds and berries
ingredient_lines: 500g bag black forest frozen fruit mix thawed
instruction_lines: Put 300g of the fruit in a bowl with the oats and yogurt. Blitz with a hand blender until very smooth. Divide between six bowls, then top each bowl with the reserved berries, nut butter, chocolate and seeds.
Serve straightaway or cover and chill until ready to eat. Will keep chilled for four days. To serve, scatter over the mint, if using.
categories: BBC Good Food healthy diet plan
